notes.title: Major Graphics Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/539ff7d727eeae4bd93f50c782558418b0687f37.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Join our Discord channel: [/b][/h3]https://discord.gg/7jUgdkbWXb


Hey folks! We already have another amazing update for you! While we are working on finalizing new quests and characters we have recently massively improved the graphics as well as the atmosphere in the game. There are new ambient sounds, the shadows are much more crisp and the light is brighter and more polished overall which makes enemies, objects like armors and weapons stand out even more than before. But that's not all. Like we said before, we are removing each UI placeholder step by step so expect smaller or bigger visual improvements in each coming update!

[h3]What has this update in store for you? Check out the list below:[/h3]

[h3][b]Higher Graphics And Better Performance![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/222a4424013516c7e98ffb85b870f28b62e14c98.jpg[/img]
The light is now brighter at spots where it's needed and darker areas look much more realistic. Shadows casted by leaves are very crisp which give you now a nice feeling of actually walking through a forest. On top of that this rendered light improves the performance again. That being said we are still working on performance drops that are not caused by the environment but by some AI errors and some other small coding issues. But we are very confident that we will soon get to the core issue of this and fix it entirely.

[h3][b]Ambient Sounds Added & Minor Sound Issues Fixed[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/8c5ae5bb377d360beb2fa1ff3f2c210f3fdcbdc6.jpg[/img]
Each location has now its own athmosphere with fitting ambient sounds of chirping birds and variation of wind sounds. These new sounds make gameplay more immersive and realistic. It's not completely done yet but the closer we get to the final Aclendi Woods version the more sounds will be added to round up the atmosphere, offering you a wonderful gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/3d8e80c27f97d799b308bd50c3522ccd55fa6038.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/4320cbd9fc73557b2b1dafa2fe33de717d386cd6.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Smoother Skin & Color Fixed[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/4d5bf0dcc2acfa4ea2fc04585180c5280408d24a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/55080fe15048b42b3012ef4da0c40f8e4baac252.jpg[/img]
There was an issue with the human character skin color which made their faces look darker and in a way pale in some areas which was not intended. This issue has finally been fixed!

[h3][b]Combat UI Text Visual Improvement[/b][/h3]
We are also currently tweaking UI elements such as combat display text and other small things regarding the HUD. Step by step we will remove all placeholders that have been a big help to us for the time being but now it's time to remove them all and make it visually appealing as well as more logical in terms of menu navigation, equipping your character and level up your skills.

That's it for this update! We hope you like this graphics update and we are already cooking up a new enemy that is going to be placed in the level soon. This one is gonna be a real pain that's as much as we can reveal to you.

notes.title: User Experience Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/526d0f4222cbf5be14350484fed4d4c6d8f941f9.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Join our Discord channel: [/b][/h3] https://discord.gg/7jUgdkbWXb


A lot of things have been tweaked and improved in this update regarding user experience and UI design. We finally got rid of multiple placeholders, adding improved UI windows and assured easier navigation overall. Next to visual improvements we also balanced the amount of items which results in smoother and more fluent gameplay.

This update is the bridge to another awesome update! We are currently working out new side quests and we are also moving forward with the main story which includes new characters, new items to collect and many other cool stuff!

[b]Check out the list below to see what comes with this update:[/b]

[h3][b]Quest Log Window[/b][/h3]
Instead of the Quest Tracker window that was appearing on the right side underneath the Minimap you can now open a Quest Log window (check Controls for input) where you can see a list of your accepted quests as well as their objectives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/a60210c328a33717d3ddcba1e58e79c273a6474a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Zoomed in Minimap & Pick Up Items Design[/b][/h3]
The Minimap is more zoomed in giving you a better overview about what's directly around you. Picked up items now appear in the bottom right corner. Up to 3 items can be simultaneously displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/71d0de66577505bdc7c6e05f8f982af47e187a5f.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Treasure Chest Design[/b][/h3]
We removed the placeholder pop up window that appeared when you opened treasure chests and added a simple open chest animation. Additionally chest icons now disappear on the Minimap and on the World Map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/63cd444b0df326868d26f0c19e6c43d0f754dd57.png[/img]

[h3][b]Improved UI Design[/b][/h3]
In general we improved a lot of elements on the UI, making them more visually appealing and easier to navigate with. It is important to say that most of the UI elements are still just placeholders and soon we will release an update with the real Menu. 

Take a look at the original Menu here:

[previewyoutube=YrItGRwuNn0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h3][b]Toggle HUD[/b][/h3]
You can now hide and unhide all UI elements by pressing "H" on the keyboard and "D-Pad Left" on gamepad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/8f895a42ae81997512d7a6549b949d110936ccbd.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3]
Fixed: Some rocks appeared blurry or appeared too late.
Fixed: Controls Menu showed wrong input.
Fixed: Some NPCs didn't appear when they should and others appeared too early.
Fixed: Picking up loot from enemies with gamepad sometimes locked the player from drinking potions.

Other corrections: typos and misleading dialogues have been corrected.

This update allows us to finally move forward with the main story and add new quests to the game! As we have fixed crucial bugs and logic errors that made quest creation a little difficult we can now get to the interesting stuff again!

[b]Stay tuned for the next update![/b]

notes.title: Update Aclendi Woods Part II & New Features
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/f976b55f57c9b6620e8c07c7e61fa79f7cf3b468.jpg[/img]
We finally made it! The announced Aclendi Woods Part II is now accessible for everyone.
Many people who attended the Polaris Convention 2024 had already the opportunity to dive into the next area with new enemies, new features and lots more to explore! Before we release this update we wanted to make sure that some annoying bugs are fixed ensuring better and smoother gameplay.

[h3][b]New Enemy Types[/b][/h3]
Like mentioned in DevLog 7 we have added three new enemies. They are much more dangerous than the previous one you encountered so watch your back before it get's stung by the brutal Xanzos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/e4c362ab8cc0be32a84cff8b88793a10d3b6cca8.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Added The Skillplate – An entirely new Combat Feature[/b][/h3]
This new Head Up Display system announced in News Post: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1344520/view/4054997065309476341?l=english is your new way to fend of hordes of enemies in an extremely quick way. It already works very well but we will make it even faster and more responsive in the future which will allow you to chain your attacks super fast. And we ain't gonna lie to you – you will need it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/d584028efbfad7a2536eb5c7914c511ae05a4d69.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Weapon Type Greatsword[/b][/h3]
We have added the Greatsword to the game! This heavy and slow weapon deals massive damage especially if you use the combo attacks correctly. Even if the weapon is huge our Prince Landon is able to wield it with ease and perform attacks that totally question physics and gravity. Many people on the Polaris 2024 loved playing with this weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/32d71d4053872686987427d202490dd776833a41.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Tutorial Changed[/b][/h3]
Due to the new features replacing all the placeholders the Tutorial is completely different now so make sure to check that out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/c79fb0d2c6fa1284a91b54c8209bf59d56143b57.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Added Tech Skills[/b][/h3]
Finally we have added Techs to Landons repertoire. These can be powerful physical attacks chanelling Landons enormous energy into a force that slices through armor like a knive through butter.

[h3][b]New Large Areas to Explore[/b][/h3]
With Aclendi Woods Part II a big area is now accessible with a lot of new hidden Items and Equipment such as Armor, Weapons, Rings etc. Additionally there is a hidden level but we are not going to tell you where obviously. And even if you knew, Hidden Levels are extremely dangerous and challenging. Only the best and sharped minded will survive here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/94f848a9931df0f2d63b5f4a04bab842703ba7d4.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Poison Player Status Effect has been added[/b][/h3]
With Poison the first player status effect is now in the game. It is just one of many but it really should not be underestimated. As most status effects Poison stacks up which means the more often you get hit the more devastating the Poison amount will be.

[h3][b]Animation Improvements, Balancing and more[/b][/h3]
To conclude this post we have done a lot of work, tweaking enemy stats to balance them, improved animations to make them look more smooth and added some other elements that you will see. We also want to say that Aclendi Woods Part III is already in the making. We are working tirelessly with the resources we have to finish Aclendi Woods, the first level in the game. Then we will continue with level two The Path of MT. Talarev.
As big updates like this usually come with issues the keyboard are currently not working properly with the new HUD system. So at the moment we highly recommend playing with gamepad. The keyboard bugs will be fixed in the coming small update which is not taking long.

[h3][b]Bug Fixes that come with this update:[/b][/h3]
Fixed Keyboard attack style Input
Fixed Gamepad attack style Input
Fixed UI Keyboard player getting stuck in Inventory
Fixed UI Keyboard player getting stuck in Level Up Window
Fixed UI Keyboard player disabled enemies with Inventory
Fixed UI Keyboard player could move while a treasure chest was opened
Fixed UI Keyboard player could attack in Inventory
Fixed UI Gamepad player getting stuck in Inventory
Fixed UI Gamepad player getting stuck in Level Up Window
Fixed UI Gamepad player disabled enemies with Inventory
Fixed UI Gamepad player could move while a treasure chest was opened
Fixed UI Gamepad player could attack in Inventory

[h3][b]Join our Discord server here:[/b][/h3] https://discord.gg/7jUgdkbWXb 

Thank you for your support, have fun and happy gaming wishes you Team Jewel Seeker!

notes.title: Game Update Released!
notes.notes:
[b]IT IS HERE - THE LONG AWAITED UPDATE THAT WILL CHANGE EVERYTHING![/b]

It is finally time to show you what we have been up to the whole time. We are celebrating the publication of a completely transformed version! You can now forget everything you knew about our old version and embrace the latest foundation of [i]Apprentice Arriving[/i]!

The 1st of 3 Major Updates specifically for the [i][b]Aclendi Woods[/b][/i] level!

[previewyoutube=N15KZWWT744;full][/previewyoutube]

This update changes the way our game looks and feels entirely. We not only cranked up the graphics and details massively. Today we present you a totally new [i][b]Aclendi Woods[/b][/i] level that is much larger than the previous one. We also want to thank you for your feedback. We fixed some critical weaknesses in our old version which were the lack of a [i][b]World Map[/b][/i], [i][b]Minimap[/b][/i] and a [i][b]Tutorial[/b][/i]. But there is a lot more to make the game feel more immersive like voice acting for important quests and we did crucial changes to the gameplay in general.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/a24ba0e2f40a9f9edd519300f0f96473efd410b1.png[/img]

[i]Apprentice Arriving[/i] now uses a new [i][b]Combat System[/b][/i] that enables fluid combos and more thrilling battles due to a better AI, a better attacking system and an armor equipping system which can be smoothly handled. There are lots of changes and eventhough this is true we have only just started with the real game. Even [i][b]Aclendi Woods[/b][/i] is just a breeze of what's to come. So stay tuned!

Feel free to give us any feedback on our [b]Discord Server:[/b] https://discord.gg/7jUgdkbWXb 
You are invited to see how [i]Apprentice Arriving[/i] finally evolves and becoming the epic story we always wanted it to be!

Here are some comparisons with the previous version and the new one showing you how much the game has changed in terms of graphics and design.

We created a new model of [i][b]Prince Landon[/b][/i] with much higher graphics, more details, High Res textures, hair physics and dynamic motions. As you can see he is fearless, he is determined and ready for any challenge that lies upon him, no matter how hard it will be!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/e2fa330e32f72f95ea618b74f0cd9d70da9c9ac1.png[/img]

Also we have polished the texture of the [i][b]Balver[/b][/i] monster because the old one didn't fit our art style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/36c4ab94e1c2fdf16f4208bd3f828b0204123191.png[/img]

The swamp area has been completely redone by replacing all assets such as trees, rocks and ground textures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/22a10c5e111484f1f4ccc05bf99e633fb83c7b65.png[/img]

The tree stump area needed an overhaul too as we realized the size didn't fit for what we had in mind. Also we wanted to make this part of the level more visually appealing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/e94aa0eb864605d432ba2f5746af65f06a022520.png[/img]

[i][h2]What secrets may the tree stump have for you? Well, you might find it out soon ... if you find a way to get to it …[/h2][/i]

Here are some additional comparisons of environments in [i][b]Aclendi Woods[/b][/i] which have been entirely changed. We wanted to have more variety so we also added a few forest clearings for more engaging battles and to make monster material farming a little easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/715b7c27cb45c3305412055aea3d49bd1180fa14.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/9873280fe9a62b6db52b106d7d0ebf40b0b402ce.png[/img]

[h2][b]NEW MENU[/b][/h2]

A new menu is in the making. The menu will give you way more features than before such as [i][b]Skilltrees[/b][/i], [i][b]Potion Mixing[/b][/i], finally the long announced [i][b]Destinyboard[/b][/i] and much more. The menu is also fully optimized for gamepad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/7090583baafb873aef403cb73675e38a26f30299.gif[/img]

Check out this video which shows how the menu currently functions:

[previewyoutube=YrItGRwuNn0;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2][b]COMBAT SYSTEM IMPROVEMENT[/b][/h2]
We are working hard on the new [i][b]Combat System[/b][/i] to make it fluent, dynamic and epic.

What we can reveal so far:

[list]
[*] Each weapon type such as [i][b]Short Sword[/b][/i], [i][b]Longsword[/b][/i] and [i][b]Greatsword[/b][/i] has it's own combo moveset
[*] We have added a feedback system that allows you to feel each hit even more
[*] You can move to all directions fluently to attack targets without having to lock on
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/dc5ef23df987ef89cff00678ad0d36207a5e9a07.png[/img]

Many areas are awaiting you! This picture shows the path to the new [i][b]Tutorial Area[/b][/i] where you will learn some basics. Important to say is that there are features that will be definitely altered as we progress with the development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/5a02b420dfebe0e3ebd13f8be2495711e828face.png[/img]

By completing quests you are not only rewarded with [i][b]Items[/b][/i] or [i][b]Gold[/b][/i] but some will even give you access to new areas of the map that are unreachable otherwise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/330cdbfee4275b7f780e9bda0e79ce70faf9debe.png[/img]

We are very happy about our [i][b]Combo System[/b][/i] as it allows us to design any combo we want. The combos are starting off rather simple but can become a little more complicated later on. Next to combos there will also be [i][b]Weapon Stances[/b][/i] where you can switch between [i][b]Fast[/b][/i], [i][b]Medium[/b][/i] and [i][b]Heavy Melee Stances[/b][/i]. It will be possible to switch your stance during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/55e4d28bf1318f6a09bedaf6d6b769cb4398d245.png[/img]

This update is part 1 of [i][b]Aclendi Woods[/b][/i]. Ultimately the level consists of 3 parts meaning that there will be 3 Major Updates to complete [i][b]Aclendi Woods[/b][/i]. With each big update we will unlock the next part of the level which will include new monsters, abilities, quests and many other exciting stuff!

[h2]This World Map shows you the areas you can explore for the moment.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/de44f86a4a6674bc2f940f6d791f494cdd761ca8.png[/img]

[h2]Next Major Update will unlock this part of the map.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/66398ffb9ab045aec9a1323889336a9a0766b0be.png[/img]

[h2]Third Major Update will unlock the rest of the map.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/2e9184095afe3873e2d0a59f8c274a4233d6cb19.png[/img]

With the third update the map will be completed so that you can explore the entire map and this includes a boss fight. In our previous version you were fighting against a [i][b]Balver EX[/b][/i] monster however this was only a [i][b]Miniboss[/b][/i]. In Major Update 3 you will encounter the real boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/2f0a8793a181b1d9ac417d4d4daab8df317a0288.png[/img]

Another important aspect we want to reveal is that each Main Level has a [i][b]Sub Level[/b][/i] or a [i][b]Secret Level[/b][/i]. Those levels are usually hidden. [i][b]Secret Levels[/b][/i] can also be very difficult and not seldom you will need a specific item in order to enter them.

We are working on a roadmap for you which will explain what you can expect during the development of [i][b]Aclendi Woods[/b][/i].

That being said we are already working on the next level. We don't want to spoiler much but one thing we can say is that the level has the name „[i][b]The Path of Mt. Talarev[/b][/i]“. We are very excited about it and we are sure you will like it as well!

So that's it for now. Everything starts here and we are already thrilled to present all the things we have planned so far!

Thank you very much for your support! See you in the next Major Update.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE COMING: 12/29/23!
notes.notes:
We are proud to finally announce an update that was long in the making. This update completely transforms the game into a fantasy RPG with quests, new stunning environments, polished enemies and so much more! Many features have been added or changed. You can fight against some of our enemies and experience the new combat system which we are non-stop polishing.

This is a milestone. With each coming update, either smaller or larger we are coming closer to our vision for Apprentice Arriving and we are happy that you can now be a part of it.

We will also create a roadmap that is going to show you what you can expect within a time frame.
For now you will be able to complete some quests and get yourself familiar with the game. Some time later we will unlock the next large area with new polished monsters and exciting content!

Now we hope you will enjoy this re-creation of the game!


[b][i] - To Learn, To Experience, To Master[/i]

Apprentice Arriving[/b]
